I’d pick **Rossi Idraulica**, subject to confirming the warranty in writing.

- **Rossi: €3,950 including VAT**, removal included. Quoted ten year warranty with annual servicing; installation in two weeks.
- **TermoCasa: €4,148 including VAT** (€3,400 + €748). Five year warranty; installation next week. Removal unspecified.

Rossi saves **€198**. Timing needs reconfirmation because the quotes are undated. Its ten year warranty also needs checking: [Vaillant’s published programme](https://www.vaillant.it/servizi/garanzia/estensione-garanzia-7-caldaie/) describes seven years.
